identity_adoption: New owner contracts adopt the exact literal identifiers and whole schema bytes listed here. Identifier spelling containing proposals preserves its identity; no frozen proposal, schema registration or validity alone establishes installed authority. Historical and current realms remain distinct.

parameter_join.rule: Actual original native owners authenticate and join complete scope/current authority independently. Materialization requires actual_bound_goal and the real previously committed Workflow association; no old native witness or caller-selected pre-Goal branch establishes current authority.

same_id_conflict_rule: Never combine conflicting resource bodies across realms; no arbitrary schema-object registration, basename resolution, network fallback or last-write-wins registry.

association_parameter_join.rule: T0 authentic BindingControl pending reservation; T1 original Workflow birth/shared Goal metadata association joint transaction; later T2 whole native materialization with current B1 and original compact association receipt. Full lower arguments are independently authenticated and joined by actual original native participants. Historical B0/W0 selectors are commitments after mutable replacement, never missing-body read prerequisites.
